This article details the commonalities and differences between [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]] and [[Grand Theft Auto IV]].  For a list of gripes about GTA IV, please visit the [[GTA IV Gripes]] page.

==Commonalities==
'''Features'''
*[[Wardrobe]]

==Differences==
===GTA San Andreas===
'''Gameplay'''
*Underwater swimming
*Flying/aircraft
*Skills (stamina, muscle, etc.)
*Automobile tanks exploding when shot
*No damage to health from major impacts while inside a car
'''Businesses'''
*[[Well Stacked Pizza]]
*[[Barbers]]
*Tattoo parlours
*[[Gyms]]
'''Features'''
*Expanded [[Clothing in GTA San Andreas|clothing]] options
*[[Vehicles|Vehicle]] customization
*Demolition derbys
*Gang member recruitment
*Turf battles
*[[Tags]]
*[[Oysters]]
*[[Horseshoes]]
*[[Weapons]] ([[Fire Extinguisher]], [[Dildo]], [[Flowers]], etc.)
*Items ([[Parachute]])
*[[Vehicles]] ([[Jetpack]])
*[[:Category:Casinos|Casinos]]
*Purchaseable [[Safehouse|safehouses]]
*[[Hot Coffee]] mod

===GTA IV===
'''Gameplay'''
*Major impacts while in an automobile can send [[Niko Bellic]] flying through the windshield
'''Features'''
*[[Flying Rats]]
*[[Multiplayer in GTA IV|Online Multiplayer]] (16 players)
*[[Ragdoll physics | Ragdoll features]]
